children: CervoMed announced that initial 12-week biomarker results from its Phase 2a nfvPPA trial will be presented as a late-breaking oral session at ISFTD 2026.
Late-breaking oral presentation accepted for ISFTD 2026 to highlight 12-week biomarker data from the Phase 2a nfvPPA trial.
Presentation based on initial data from first eight participants and will report biomarkers (NfL, GFAP) from at least 22 participants.
Phase 2a trial enrolled 25 participants across U.S. and U.K. sites to assess safety, PK, and clinical effects of neflamapimod in nfvPPA.
Neflamapimod is an oral p38α inhibitor in development for FTD-related nfvPPA and other neurodegenerative indications; it holds FDA orphan drug designation for FTD.
